deepalchemy.storefront: deepalchemy.app becomes the storefront: models and kernels for sale.

tiers.CRIMSON: the top tier — Nathan's to KEEP. Never sold, never listed. His personal vault.
tiers.MYTHIC: SOLD — earns the QEMU bare-metal proof. The rarest work offered.
tiers.LEGENDARY: listed as FREE — a gift to the community.
tiers.BELOW: REPURPOSED — broken down for parts, never sold as-is.

deepalchemy.standing_rule: models are AI-generated from this point forward. No exceptions.
deepalchemy.deepalchemy_ai: deepalchemy.ai holds the unified theory (Alchemedies Principle) + examples of dimensional models.
deepalchemy.pipeline: AI generates -> Dentauri fast loop -> tier judged -> LEGENDARY (free) / BEST (sold) / rest (repurposed). Mythic kernels still earn QEMU for the bare-metal proof.

deepalchemy_ai_role.role: deepalchemy.ai is the SANDBOX and MODEL VIEWER.
deepalchemy_ai_role.sandbox: a sandbox for creating things — the workshop where work gets made.
deepalchemy_ai_role.viewer: a model viewer for game assets and anything raijinsocial creates — the gallery of output.
deepalchemy_ai_role.division: deepalchemy.app SELLS (storefront, tiers). deepalchemy.ai MAKES and SHOWS (sandbox + viewer). raijinsocial.com is the world/mandala.
deepalchemy_ai_role.unified_theory: deepalchemy.ai also holds the Alchemedies Principle (unified theory) + dimensional model examples.
